No, Canadian citizens who are not U.S. permanent residents cannot qualify for SBA 7(a) loans to purchase American businesses.

As of March 2025, the SBA implemented strict citizenship requirements. The agency "banned foreign nationals and non-citizens from accessing SBA-guaranteed small business loans." Only U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents with principal residences in the U.S. are eligible.

One source directly addresses your situation: "if you are a Canadian citizen you do not quality for an SBA 7A loan to acquire a US business unless you are a citizen, green card holder, or have one of the other statues outlined below."

Previously, non-citizens could own up to 49% of a business and still qualify. That flexibility no longer exists under Executive Order 14159.
